data.title: DraftKings employs AI to target customers at high risk of losing bets. They don't use it to help prevent gambling addiction.
data.description: The use of data science plays a key role in determining eligibility for betting incentives, with the company leveraging this technology. However, the company has been reluctant to apply similar data-driven approaches to safeguard individuals at risk of addiction from gambling-related harm. The technology involves analyzing significant numbers and patterns to make informed decisions on providing betting incentives, yet a disparity exists in the application of this analytical tool towards promoting responsible gambling behavior.
